analysis.purpose: cmdDossier implements the `crib dossier` CLI command. It resolves a single positional symbol id, validates the arguments, opens the verb/index store, and prints the requested dossier in either JSON or Markdown format with optional table inclusion and extracted-only filtering.
responsibilities: Extract a single positional symbol id from the argument list
Print usage and return BAD_ARGS when no id is provided
Open the verb/index store via openVerbs
Return NOT_INDEXED if the store cannot be opened
Call verbs.dossier with optional flags and emit formatted output
Close the index store before returning

businessRules.rule: A dossier id must be a non-flag positional argument
businessRules.rationale: The id is found via args.find((a) => !a.startsWith('-'))
When !id, the function writes usage to stderr and returns EXIT.BAD_ARGS

businessRules.rule: Format defaults to undefined (JSON) and only accepts markdown
businessRules.rationale: format is set to 'markdown' only when args[fmtIdx+1] === 'markdown'; otherwise it remains undefined

businessRules.rule: Dossier modifiers are enabled only when their flags are present
businessRules.rationale: includeTables and extractedOnly are included only if the corresponding args.includes check is true

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: CLI arguments including symbol id, --format, --include-tables, and --extracted-only

sideEffects: Writes usage text to process.stderr when arguments are missing
Writes formatted dossier JSON to process.stdout on success
Opens and closes the index store
errorBehavior: openVerbs failure returns EXIT.NOT_INDEXED without writing output
invariants: The index store is closed before the function returns
Only a single id is accepted; multiple positionals are not explicitly rejected but only the first non-flag is used
preconditions: A valid symbol id must be present
The crib index must be openable
postconditions: Either the requested dossier is printed or an error code is returned
risks: Manual flag parsing is permissive; invalid --format values silently default to JSON
4 unresolved call sites (Array.find, String.startsWith, process.stderr.write, JSON.stringify) are not modeled
whatToDistrust: Unresolved built-in calls: find, startsWith, process.stderr.write, JSON.stringify
verbs.dossier contract and behavior are not validated in this seed
